inventory-searcher.settings.excluded.too: Look at a container in the world and press the exclude key to exclude it or include it again.
Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape unbinds it. Look at a container and press this key to exclude it from searching, or include it again.
inventory-searcher.settings.rotate.toolt: Looks at each container before opening it.
inventory-searcher.settings.swing.toolti: Swings your hand when opening a container.
inventory-searcher.settings.keybind.tool: The key to open the terminal is under Inventory Searcher in the controls.
inventory-searcher.settings.open_delay.t: Ticks to wait between two containers.
inventory-searcher.settings.open_timeout: Ticks to wait for a container to open before skipping it.
inventory-searcher.settings.clicks_per_t: How many inventory clicks to send per tick when moving items.
inventory-searcher.settings.show_shulker: Also lists the items inside shulker boxes stored in the containers. Those can only be taken out as a whole box.
inventory-searcher.settings.sort.tooltip: How the items in the terminal are sorted.
